echo_refund.001: On the way down, every clock in the building changes its mind at once.
echo_refund.003: My clock has been running one hour and forty-seven minutes fast. I would rather not discuss why.
echo_refund.004: I have returned the difference. Please spend it inside the building.
echo_refund.005: In the window, the sky that had started thinking about morning thinks better of it, and goes back to being night.
